storage.title: What gets saved
storage.gameDescription: Player names, final scores, number of hands, the record source, a copy of the original game record and replay data.
storage.analysisDescription: Candidate actions and AI probabilities for all four players, the model name and version, and the date and time of the analysis.
storage.desktop: Analysis results are saved in the results folder on this computer and can be opened from your history. You can change the folder in settings; your history will then show the results in the new folder.
storage.desktopTransfer: Analysis runs entirely on this computer. The internet is used only to download game records from Tenhou URLs.
storage.web: Game records, replay data, analysis results and history are saved on the server. A browser cookie stores only the key used to access your history.
storage.cookie: If you delete this cookie, you will lose access to your history in this browser. The saved data remains on the server.
storage.delete: Choosing “Delete analysis” on a history entry deletes the saved analysis, the entry and its copy of the game record.
settings.title: Storage settings
share.title: Share link
share.description: Anyone with this link can view the player names, all players' hands and the AI analysis.
share.copyManually: The link is selected. Copy it manually.
share.deleteHint: The share link will stop working if you delete this analysis.
storage.sharing: The web app automatically creates a share link for each analysis. Anyone with the link can view the player names, all players' hands and the AI analysis. Deleting the analysis also disables its link.
